newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE to introduce s-term futures margin offsets.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE to introduce s-term futures margin offsets.

text.p: Futures firms will be able to offset margins between short-term interest rate futures denominated in different currencies, the London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange (LIFFE) said on Friday.

The London Clearing House (LCH) has approved cross currency short-term interest rate margin offsets, following the introduction of cross currency bond margin offsets in 1992, LIFFE said in a statement.
"The growing inter-relationship between European currencies in the run-up to EMU...has led to the extension of this policy," LIFFE said.
Margin offsets for interest rate futures will be introduced from July 14, the exchange added.
"This will reduce the capital cost associated with spread trading at a time when profit margins...are tightening," said Daniel Hodson, LIFFE Chief Executive.
